points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable archive builds in restricted cfd-bench with bundled externals; CTest registers no tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:68–70 loads restart; io.cpp:221–238 returns on rank0 for missing/invalid file before other ranks enter MPI_Bcast, risking hang. Valid restart restores U only, not BDF history/time.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates CGNS mesh/partition, solver and IO; original historical result artifacts are retained in contestant attempt.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct wrapper found; no external similarity or authorship investigation performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:57–60 parses supplied case and resolves its CGNS mesh path.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: solver.cpp:115–123 builds local mesh and clears global mesh within setup; METIS and neighbor exchange exist. Restart error path can hang across ranks.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: State clamps exist, but restart error can deadlock and Re200 target-success status is not credible.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean source builds; CTest registers no tests. Historical validator passed structural checks, not numerical validity.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source is compact; clean curated TeX build fails unescaped underscores in results_table.tex and historical executable is unbound.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
